objection.quote: Remaining crux: **prove shrinkage stops** (equivalently: finitely many permanents / $S_\infty$ finitely generated).
objection.witness: The missing statement is an all-terms finiteness or large-prime-erasure lemma: membership must depend only on primes in one fixed finite set, with every large-prime-containing term handled. The quote explicitly defers precisely this finiteness step, while the empirical checks do not prove it.
objection.load_bearing: A finite relevant prime set is needed to choose a finite modulus $L$. The write-up has no unconditional route from its framework to such an $L$.
